route: Civitanova Marche - San Benedetto del Tronto

intermediate.name: 3rd passage of the finish line
intermediate.title: Sprint | 3rd passage of the finish line (98.4 km)

story: A three-rider breakaway went clear from the start. On the day’s only climb, Mathieu van der Poel reduced the peloton to about 30 riders, dropping the sprinters. After they were caught with 60 km left, Jonas Abrahamsen attacked late but was caught at 400 meters, before Jonathan Milan sprinted to victory ahead of Welsford and Rex.
